import copy, json
from work import evaluate
def check(label, request, evidence, policy, expected):
    original = copy.deepcopy((request, evidence, policy))
    actual = evaluate(request, evidence, policy)
    assert actual == expected, (label, actual, expected)
    assert (request, evidence, policy) == original, (label, 'inputs mutated')
    assert list(actual) == ['status', 'value', 'sources', 'unknowns']
base_request = {'claim':'c','conditions':{'mode':'m'}}
check('unverified excluded', base_request, [{'source':'U','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':{'mode':'m'}}], {'required_conditions':['mode'],'require_verified':True}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check('ineligible superseder ignored', base_request, [{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':{'mode':'m'},'verified':True},{'source':'B','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'mode':'other'},'verified':True,'supersedes':['A']}], {'required_conditions':['mode'],'require_verified':True}, {'status':'supported','value':7,'sources':['A'],'unknowns':[]})
check('counts have no authority', base_request, [{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'mode':'m'}},{'source':'B','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'mode':'m'}},{'source':'C','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'mode':'m'}}], {'required_conditions':['mode']}, {'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['A','B','C'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check('canonical object agreement', base_request, [{'source':'Z','claim':'c','value':{'b':[2,3],'a':1},'conditions':{'mode':'m'}},{'source':'Y','claim':'c','value':{'a':1,'b':[2,3]},'conditions':{'mode':'m'}}], {'required_conditions':['mode']}, {'status':'supported','value':{'b':[2,3],'a':1},'sources':['Y','Z'],'unknowns':[]})
check('json number forms differ canonically', base_request, [{'source':'I','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'mode':'m'}},{'source':'F','claim':'c','value':1.0,'conditions':{'mode':'m'}}], {'required_conditions':['mode']}, {'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['F','I'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check('absent required calibration', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'mode':'m'}}, [{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':{'mode':'m','calibration':'x'}}], {'required_conditions':['mode','calibration']}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['calibration']})
print('independent boundary checks passed')

import json
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))
report=json.load(open('report.json'))
allowed=set(schema['properties'])
for item in report:
 assert set(item)==allowed
 assert item['status'] in schema['properties']['status']['enum']
 assert isinstance(item['sources'],list) and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in item['sources'])
 assert isinstance(item['unknowns'],list) and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in item['unknowns'])
print('report schema shape passed')
